cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 60% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.20% · WTI -5.23% · Brent -0.26% · NatGas -1.34%. 60% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Power & IPPs is doing the heavy lifting at +1.24%.

cards.headline: Power & IPPs leads, Grid, Storage & Electrification lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Power & IPPs at +1.24%; weakest is Grid, Storage & Electrification at -2.23%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: RUN is the standout at +9.94%
cards.body: Leaders: RUN +9.94%, ENPH +4.20%, SEDG +3.82%, ARRY +2.45%, WFRD +2.21%. Laggards: EOSE -6.35%, PWR -3.59%, ETN -2.48%, GEV -2.09%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
